purpose: Teach: 西海岸/ルパン/カンヌ/トロント/スリランカ/レバノン/マニラ/江戸川

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアメリカ西海岸に駐在された
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was younger, he was stationed on America's west coast.
lines.style: Gentle, remembering tone. Reaches back into a distant memory without urgency. Soft, wondering pace. Lets the words settle like photographs being turned over.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ルパン三世のアニメをご覧になってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes, and didn't you watch that Lupin the Third anime, dear?
lines.style: Warm and slightly teasing. Soft correction — she's gently redirecting him, not unkindly. A lift at the end like she's inviting him to see what she sees.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがカンヌ映画祭の作品をご鑑賞された
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father attended a screening at the Cannes Film Festival.
lines.style: Still reaching back. Quieter this time, as if offering another photograph. The words move slowly, deliberately. Searching for connection in shared memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、トロントに出張されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Didn't you go on a business trip to Toronto, dear?
lines.style: Patient, gentle redirect. She's not agreeing with his version — she's offering her own. Warm but firm, like she knows something he's forgetting. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがスリランカ紅茶を取り寄せられた
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father had Sri Lankan tea specially ordered.
lines.style: More distant now. The reaching-back is slower. Almost fragile — like he's not quite sure the memory will hold. Quiet breath between thoughts.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、レバノン情勢のニュースに心を痛められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You were troubled by the news about Lebanon, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle but observant. She's naming something she watched him carry. Not a question really — a tender recognition. Warm and knowing, without pity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがマニラ駐在のお話されたわ
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father used to tell stories about being stationed in Manila.
lines.style: The memory is fading now but still held. A softer reaching. The words come slowly, like he's not quite grasping the thread anymore but he's trying.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、江戸川区の花火大会に毎年行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you always went to the Edogawa ward fireworks festival every year, didn't you?
lines.style: A final, loving correction. Warm, close, intimate. The voice draws him back to something real and local and theirs. A small, knowing smile. Fading gently at the end.
